segments.text: We first tried Cloud accounting in 209. At the time, efficiency needs mattered because we needed visibility across branches.
The biggest issue was Power outages. Without steady power in Aba, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Cloud accounting—we saw Operational efficiency within 12 months.
Policy-wise, Regulatory licenses shaped our move. We adjusted by Alternative power.
Data helped; even a low-code AutoML gave us clearer demand patterns during Easter.
